sn54.10:1.2: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Kimbilāyam viharati Veḷuvane || || 2.
sn54.10:1.3: Tatra kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Kimbilam āmantesi ||
sn54.10:1.4: Katham bhāvito nu kho Kimbila ānāpānasatisamādhi katham bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso ti || ||
sn54.10:2.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Kimbilo tuṇhī ahosi || || 3.
sn54.10:2.3: Tatiyam pi kho Bhagavā āyasmantam Kimbilam āmantesi ||
sn54.10:2.4: Katham bhāvito nu kho Kimbila ānāpānasatisamādhi katham bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso ti || ||
sn54.10:2.5: Tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Kimbilo tuṇhī ahosi || || 5.
sn54.10:3.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn54.10:3.2: Etassa Bhagavā kālo || etassa Sugata kālo
sn54.10:3.3: yam Bhagavā ānāpānasatisamādhim bhāveyya || Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī ti || ||
sn54.10:4.1: Tenahānanda suṇāhi sādhukam manasi karohi bhāsissāmī ti || ||
sn54.10:4.2: Evam bhante ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paccassosi || || 6.
sn54.10:4.4: Katham bhāvito ca Ānanda ānāpānasatisamādhi katham bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso || || 7--13.
sn54.10:4.5: Idhānanda bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā
sn54.10:4.8: Evam bhāvito kho Ānanda ānāpānasatisamādhi evam bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso || || 15.
sn54.10:5.1: Yasmiṃ samaye Ānanda bhikkhu dīghaṃ vā assasanto Dīgham assasāmīti pajānāti || dīghaṃ vā passasanto Dīgham passasāmīti pajānā ti ||
sn54.10:5.2: rassaṃ vā assasanto Rassam assasāmīti pajānāti || rassam vā passasanto Rassam passasāmīti pajānā ti ||
sn54.10:5.3: sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī Assasissāmī ti sikkhati || sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī Passasissāmī ti sikkhati ||
sn54.10:5.4: passam bhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāram Assasissāmī ti sikkhati || passam bhayam kāyasaṅkhāram Passasissāmī ti sikkhati ||
sn54.10:5.5: kāye kāyanupassī Ānanda bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam ||
sn54.10:5.7: Kāyaññatarāham Ānanda etaṃ vadami yadidam assāsapassāsaṃ ||
sn54.10:5.8: tasmā ti hānanda kāye kāyānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 17.
sn54.10:6.1: Tasmiṃ samaye Ānanda bhikkhu pītipaṭisaṃvedī Assasissāmī ti sikkhati || pītipaṭisaṃvedī Passasissāmī ti sikkhati ||
sn54.10:6.2: sukhapaṭisaṃvedī Assasissāmī ti sikkhati || sukhapaṭisaṃvedī Passasissāmī ti sikkhati ||
sn54.10:6.3: cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī Assasissāmī ti sikkhati || cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī Passasissāmī ti sikkhati ||
sn54.10:6.4: passam bhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāram Assasissāmī ti sikkhati || passam bhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāram Passasissāmī ti sikkhati ||
sn54.10:6.5: Vedānāsu vedanānupassī Ānanda bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpi sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn54.10:6.7: Vedanāññatarāham Ānanda etam vadāmi yad idaṃ assāsapassāsaṃ sādhukam manasikāraṃ ||
sn54.10:6.8: tasmā ti hānanda vedanāsu vedanānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 19.
sn54.10:7.1: Yasmiṃ samaye Ānanda bhikkhu cittapaṭisaṃvedī Assasissāmī ti sikkhati || cittapaṭisaṃvedī Passasissāmī ti sikkhati ||
sn54.10:7.4: vimocayaṃ cittam Assasissāmī ti sikkhati || vimocayaṃ cittam Passasissāmī ti sikkhati || ||
sn54.10:7.5: Citte cittānupassī Ānanda bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam ||
sn54.10:7.7: Nāham Ānanda muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa ānāpānasatisamādhibhāvanaṃ vadāmi ||
sn54.10:7.8: tasmā ti hānanda citte cittānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 21.
sn54.10:8.1: Yasmiṃ samaye Ānanda bhikkhu aniccānupassī Assasissāmī ti sikkhati || la ||
sn54.10:8.4: paṭinissaggānupassī Assasissāmiti sikkhati || paṭinissaggānupassī Passasissāmī ti sikkhati ||
sn54.10:8.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī Ānanda bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn54.10:8.6: so yaṃ taṃ hoti abhijjhādomanassānam pahānam tam paññāya divā sādhukam ajjhupekkhitā hoti ||
sn54.10:8.7: tasmā ti hānanda dhammesu dhammānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 22.
